market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $45,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC currently ~$76,500. The 2026 low so far is ~$60K. To dip to $45K requires another 25% drop from the recent low or ~41% from spot in 8 months. Plausible only in a deep bear leg; base rates for that magnitude of additional drawdown after an already-39% decline from peak are roughly 20-25%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Path of macro recession risk and Iran-related shocks over the next 8 months
